sentences.en: I read this tome from end to end.
sentences.zh: 我从头到尾读完了这本巨著。

sentences.en: Tome squirted some washing-up liquid in the dishwasher, but regretted it afterwards.
sentences.zh: 汤姆往洗碗机里挤了些洗洁精，后来他后悔了。

sentences.en: This tome could snap my spine.
sentences.zh: 这本巨著差点把我脊椎给折断了。

senses.zh: 大部头巨著；（几卷中的）一册
